caller: actual runtime.cli_v1.mcp_server stdio process; public interface_observe then interface_dispatch
cleanup: close only the owned fixture HWND/process; preserve raw report if its state is uncertain
dispatch: one finite program: focus, click/down+up, known text, Ctrl+S, wait, observe, release_all; source.target_generations is copied from the immediately preceding public observe receipt
input_scope: visible foreground window is the owned fixture; no other target is configured or acted on
platform: Windows local desktop; user-authorized host use
release_pass: public report has final release receipt verified=true, no keys/buttons down, and no unknown keys/buttons
retry_policy: one dispatch only; unknown/timeout never retried
target: one fresh process-owned Agent Interface Win32 fixture window; exact configured HWND only
target_generation_claim: one live positive path forwards the immediately preceding matching Win32 observation generation through the standard caller and completes admission

task.effect: fixture writes one JSON record with saved=true, exact text, clicked=true
task.independent_oracle: read fixture effect file and JSONL event journal after the public MCP call; use monotonic_ns for event, file commit, public call and readback boundaries

task_pass: independent effect JSON exactly matches the frozen task and event journal has exact character count plus one save
timing_claim: one descriptive sample of public observation/dispatch, fixture input/save, independent file readback, and release receipt observation; no matched comparison or general latency claim
